arguments.command: python3 -c " import urllib.request req = urllib.request.Request('https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/ap060121.html') req.add_header('User-Agent', 'Mozilla/5.0') resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) content = resp.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace') # Find title and description import re title_match = re.search(r'(.*?)', content, re.DOTALL) if title_match: print('TITLE:', title_match.group(1).strip()) # Find the explanation text desc_match = re.search(r'Explanation:(.*?)', content, re.DOTALL) if desc_match: print('DESCRIPTION:', desc_match.group(1).strip()) # Find astronaut names astronauts = re.findall(r'(?:astronaut|cosmonaut)s?\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)+)', content) if astronauts: print('ASTRONAUTS:', astronauts) else: # Try finding names near 'astronaut' keyword for match in re.finditer(r'([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)+).*?(?:astronaut|cosmonaut)', content): print('NAME:', match.group(1)) print(content[:3000]) " 2>&1
